title: Choose the model for the job

body.text: How to choose within the Gemini family:
Flash → fast, high-volume work · Flash Thinking → fast work that needs logic · Pro → the deepest, most complex work
— start with the smaller model and move up when quality isn't enough, saving time and cost.

example: "Daily news summary → Flash / contract analysis → Pro / automatic form-logic checks → Flash Thinking"
